title: Zesty Syrian Eggplant Stir-fry
description: A jammy, pillowy dish of sautéed eggplant and bell pepper tossed in a fiery red chili sauce, perfect for a quick festive meal.
instructions: Heat the wok over medium-high heat and add the olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and chopped red chili pepper, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add the eggplant strips and cook, stirring frequently, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and continue to stir-fry for another 3 minutes.
Pour in the tomato sauce, then sprinkle the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the mixture for 4 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh parsley or a squeeze of lemon juice.
